ProxyEnv Switch 1.2.1
=====================

ProxyEnvSwitch_x64.exe
  Use on most Intel or AMD 64-bit Windows 11 computers.

ProxyEnvSwitch_ARM64.exe
  Use on Windows 11 ARM64 computers.

The application adds, updates, or removes the current user's persistent
HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY environment variables. Administrator rights are not
required.

The executables are not commercially code-signed. Microsoft Defender
SmartScreen may display an unrecognized-app warning. Verify SHA256SUMS.txt or
build the application from source before running it.
